budget_rule: probe {4,8,16,32,64} on calibration groups of sub24; middle budget = the probe at which the best flat code's mean Brier lies in [0.03, 0.12] (only 8: 0.0642; 16: 0.0154 near ceiling; 32: 0.0039; 64: 0.0); budgets = its neighbours
fit_certificate: Frank-Wolfe gap <= 1e-6 nats on every fit (calibration v2: 89,400/89,400 certified, max 1.0e-6)
flat_rule: lowest calibration mean Brier at B=8 on sub24 among gate, cgh_flat, circuit, index (tie order as listed)

interpretation_rules.growing_with_n: requires the intact correlation with n and the ladder sub12<sub24<sub48 to agree in sign; sub48 has 2 groups and cannot carry a claim
interpretation_rules.null: interval includes 0 -> no detected advantage at scale
interpretation_rules.positive_on_published_models: sub24 primary interval at B=8 excludes 0 with positive sign and survives missingness bounds

method_rule: lowest calibration mean Brier at B=8 on sub24 among a in {1,4,16} x {full, leave-target-out} for XDC-EB over the chosen flat base

population.groups_seen_in_n8: every evaluation group of every panel also contributed 8-node fragments to an R5 or R6 n=8 panel; the without-seen-groups analysis is therefore empty and is reported as not computable
population.why: intact if >= 20 eligible intact groups, else sub24 (protocol S2 fallback); intact has 13 groups

predictions_recorded_before_evaluation.growth_with_n: not expected: the sharing gain at calibration does not increase from sub12 to sub24 materially
predictions_recorded_before_evaluation.intact: near ceiling at B>=8; any effect at B=4 only; too few groups (12) for a firm statement
predictions_recorded_before_evaluation.sub12: about zero or negative (calibration: method 0.0620 vs flat[circuit] 0.0598 at B=8)

primary: Brier(flat[circuit]) - Brier(xdc_eb[circuit]|a16|loo) at B=8 on sub24 evaluation groups; source-group cluster bootstrap 10,000 reps seed 20261111; worst-case missingness bounds. Positive favours sharing.
secondaries: exact xdc[gate|cgh_flat] where n<=12 (sub12, intact n<=12)
intact panel (n 9-60): effect and correlation with n
effect vs non-constant rule reuse and clamped-edge fraction

seen_before_lock.calibration_v1: identical to 4 decimals; 27/89,400 fits uncertified under plain EM (fixed by SQUAREM, tolerance declared 1e-6)

status: DEVELOPMENT design lock for Track S (not a confirmatory freeze); committed before any evaluation-group score
